findings.description: Typography-size literals `font-size: 12px` (label/th/count/stat-label) and `font-size: 13px` (timeline title) have exact matching tokens `--fs-caption` (12px) and `--fs-label` (13px) that ARE defined in GlobalStyle and ARE used elsewhere in the very same files (e.g. Ctrl ErrorText uses var(--fs-caption), Table body uses tokens). Consistency nit only — these are typography SIZES, not colors/radii, so they fall outside the WI-2a coexistence flag list, and the components still render entirely from CSS custom properties. No functional or theming impact (both light/dark inherit correctly). Prefer var(--fs-caption)/var(--fs-label) for uniformity. Stat value 26px and DeskSegmented inner 6px radius have NO matching token in the ramp/radii set and are legitimate layout literals.

notes.coexistence: PASS. Zero hardcoded hex colors, zero rgba(), zero import of shared/theme/theme.ts across the entire desk kit. All color/radius/shadow/scrim/motion values read GlobalStyle CSS custom properties.
notes.styled_components: PASS. Every style prop is transient ($variant/$size/$selected/$accent/$hasError/$disabled/$tone/$active/$on/$num/$direction) — no non-DOM attribute leak. One exported component per file, PascalCase.tsx, JSDoc on every exported interface + component.
notes.a11y: PASS. All 11 components carry a vitest-axe assertion via '../../test/axe' (= @/shared/test/axe helper). Semantics: Table uses table/th/td with $num right-align; Tabs uses role=tablist/tab + aria-selected + roving tabIndex + ArrowLeft/Right + focus-follows-selection; FilterChip + DeskSegmented use real <button> + aria-pressed; Drawer uses role=dialog + aria-modal + focus trap (Tab/Shift+Tab wrap) + Escape + focus restore to trigger + --scrim + token focus ring; uppercase is CSS-only (text-transform), DOM text preserved; icons decorative aria-hidden or role=img+title.
notes.i18n: PASS. No hardcoded user-facing strings in kit components — all text arrives via props (title/label/children); accessible names via required label props (Drawer.closeLabel, Tabs.ariaLabel, DeskSegmented.ariaLabel).
notes.typescript: PASS. No `any`, no `as any`. Explicit JSX.Element / JSX.Element|null return types on all exported components; typed unions for variants/tones/directions.
notes.icons: PASS. Purely additive — 5 new glyphs (arrow-up, arrow-down, sun, moon, download) added to BOTH the IconName union AND the PATHS record; existing glyphs byte-untouched; Icon.test.tsx covers all 5 new names via it.each plus the decorative/labelled/size/axe cases.
notes.checks: tsc --noEmit, eslint, and scoped vitest (88 tests) all green per background run. Pre-existing unrelated acceptHydration.test.tsx failure explicitly out of scope.
